"""Search for a request whose minimal DFA is large; measure output size."""
import importlib.util
import json
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("mainmod", "/workspace/submission/main.py")
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

rng = random.Random(99)
alphabet = ["s%02d" % i for i in range(24)]
best = None
for trial in range(60):
    atoms = []
    for i in range(10):
        op = rng.choice(("endswith", "contains", "match", "startswith"))
        atoms.append((op, [rng.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(rng.randint(10, 16))]))
    req = {"services": alphabet,
           "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "and", "args": [
               {"op": "not", "arg": {"op": op, "path": p}} for op, p in atoms]}}],
           "queries": []}
    payload = (json.dumps(req) + "\n").encode()
    t0 = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "/workspace/submission/main.py"], input=payload,
                       capture_output=True, timeout=300)
    el = time.time() - t0
    out = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
    if not out.get("ok"):
        print("trial", trial, out)
        continue
    size = len(out["dfa"]["accept"])
    if best is None or size > best[0]:
        best = (size, el, len(p.stdout), req)
    print("trial %2d states=%5d time=%.2fs bytes=%d" % (trial, size, el, len(p.stdout)))
print("BEST:", best[0], "time %.2f" % best[1], "bytes", best[2])
PYEOF
